description: Weekly export sales time series for one commodity, and optionally one destination country, from the same FAS ESR weekly reports behind get_export_sales. Use for demand trends across weeks; use get_export_sales instead when only the latest week matters, and compare_contracts_vs_shipments to set contracted sales against actual shipments. Read-only lookup of stored reports; no API key. Returns up to `weeks` most recent weeks, oldest first (default 12, max 52); without a `country`, each week covers all destinations combined as stored.

country.description: GENC country code (e.g. CHN, MEX) or omit for all destinations

weeks.description: Number of most recent weeks to return (default 12, max 52)

name: get_export_sales_history
